 Business Descriptor: 
We are currently seeking a fresher to join the AMIN (HSBC Asset Management (India) Private Limited) Sales & Distribution team. 
The role is responsible for managing the distributor channel network - viz Banks, National Distributors and IFA (Independent Financial Adviser(s) to ensure high mind share for our products through innovative promotional schemes and deliver aggressive sales budgets. 
 Key Responsibilities 
Manage key focus distributors across Banks including Wealth and Personal Banking Segment & National Distributors 
Work closely with Group Distribution entities to strengthen the network 
Build new distribution channels and penetration opportunities within the IFA segment. 
Focusing and developing new areas in terms of business expansion, identifying potential counters to increase market share. 
Develop & own Regional level relationships based out in the region. 
Demonstrate the right behaviors by doing business the right way and live by HSBC values. 
The role at times requires a direct interface with the client. A mature person with the ability to promote & sell and discuss the markets with ease would be an ideal fit. 
 Qualifications 
The successful candidate for this role will need to possess the following skills and experience: 
A good understanding of mutual fund products. 
Strong selling skills & commercial acumen 
Good verbal and written communication, leadership and interpersonal skills 
The inclination to work in a client facing, sales role 
AMFI (Association of Mutual Funds in India) certification is desired 
Candidates who do not meet the experience / educational qualifications but have a passion for mutual fund sales are also welcome to apply 
Mandatory to successfully complete NISM VA, Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required. 
 Additional Information : 
 The tenure of the Apprentice will be 1 (one) year as defined under Apprentices Act, 1961 and Apprenticeship Rules 1992 amended from time to time. 
 All Apprentices engaged by the Company will also be featured in NATS portal as an ‘Apprentice’. 
 By virtue of them being covered under the provisions of the Act, a candidate profile will be created for each apprentice in the NATS portal, which will be available to them for viewing. 
 On completion of the one-year Apprenticeship tenure, a Certificate of Proficiency will be issued to the apprentice by the Govt. of India, as applicable under the Act and the enrollment under the Apprenticeship Act will cease. 
 All other clauses regarding the tenure of engagement as an Apprentice with HSBC will stand as mentioned in the offer letter issued by the Company at the time of joining. 
 Note: 
As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.

 Timely reporting of discrepancies and expedite resolution for the same.

 About GIA Finance 
You will be part of the team that executes the GIA Finance Audit plan across the key markets for the bank, primarily Group and UK. Its coverage includes: 
Financial Reporting and Regulatory Reporting 
Risk-Weighted Assets calculation and reporting, Liquidity regulatory reporting such as LCR, NSFR and other prudential regulatory reporting.

Group strategic management activities relevant to Finance 
Taxation and ESG disclosures

Trace data and reported balances from source systems through transformations, reconciliations and manual adjustments to regulatory or financial reports, and identify breaks in the audit trail.

Strong working knowledge of Excel and practical exposure to data analytics tools such as Python, SQL or Alteryx. 
Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to organise information and explain conclusions logically.

HSBC’s Asset & Wealth Management is primarily responsible for driving mutual fund sales through distributor networks and client relationships, while ensuring compliance and delivering market insights to advisors and investors. 
 Core responsibilities 
Distributor & IFA channel development: Build and manage relationships with banks, independent financial advisors (IFAs), and national distributors; expand the IFA network and deepen penetration in the assigned region. 
Sales targets & AUM growth: Own quarterly/annual sales budgets, focus on assets under management (AUM) growth, and meet/exceed mutual fund sales targets. 
Client/advisor engagement: Present fund strategies, market views, and portfolio solutions to IFAs, relationship managers, and institutional clients; support them in client conversations and portfolio reviews. 
Training & enablement: Conduct internal/external training sessions, product workshops, and webinars for RM/IC teams and advisors; create sales plans around “focus funds” and campaigns. 
Market intelligence: Gather feedback from the field, share competitor and flow trends, and work with product teams to refine positioning and campaigns. 
Compliance & documentation: Ensure all sales activities adhere to SEBI/AMFI guidelines, KYC/AML norms, and internal risk/compliance policies; maintain accurate records and reporting. 
 Requirements 
Certifications: NISM VA certification is mandatory 
Education: Graduate/postgraduate in finance, business, or related fields. 
Skills: Strong relationship management, negotiation, presentation skills; comfort with sales pipelines, Excel/CRM reporting, and basic portfolio analytics.

 Business Descriptor: 
Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening
up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance. 
 Job Introduction 
The Business Development Manager will be responsible for driving awareness, origination, and facilitation of GIFT City–based banking and wealth products by engaging with onshore India teams and key international corridors. The role focuses on building strong referral ecosystems, activating cross-border opportunities, and converting India-linked and offshore client interest into sustainable GIFT City business. 
 Principal Responsibilities 
To present a competitive GIFT City IWPB proposition which will help the Bank gain a higher market share into the customer’s wallet by presenting a differentiated offering and add to cross-sell revenue. 
Drive business growth for GIFT City products across banking, deposits, investments, and wealth solutions. 
Corridor & ecosystem engagement to develop and execute corridor-specific strategies (e.g., Middle East, Singapore) aligned with NRI, HNI, UHNI client segments. 
Build and manage relationships with international offices, overseas branches. 
Conduct market visits, roadshows, and client engagement programs in overseas corridors to promote GIFT City offerings. 
Act as a bridge between onshore, offshore, and GIFT City teams to ensure seamless deal facilitation and execution. 
Drive product awareness and education across international teams on GIFT City propositions, regulatory advantages, and client use cases. 
Support structuring of cross-border solutions in collaboration with product, investment, and wealth teams. 
Provide market feedback to product and leadership teams to refine offerings and sharpen competitiveness. 
Own end-to-end coordination for referred business including onboarding support, documentation facilitation, and stakeholder management. 
Ensure timely conversion of leads into funded deposits, or investments. 
Track pipeline, conversions, and revenue outcomes against defined targets. 
Support leadership with corridor insights, growth themes, and strategic initiatives. 
 Requirements 
Post Graduate in any discipline; MBA or equivalent professional qualification preferred. 
8–10 years of experience in business development, relationship management, international banking, wealth management, or cross-border business. 
Strong exposure to NRI / offshore client segments, international corridors, or global banking products. 
High comfort with travel and external stakeholder engagement 
Strong communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills
